title: Twelve-Week Foundation
summary: An 84-day plan for building the SAT from the ground up at a sustainable 4–7 hours a week: learn every domain in order, build reading stamina and Desmos fluency, and test every three weeks before a two-week taper.

resources.label: SAT Practice Bank (filter by domain, skill and difficulty)

error_codes.meaning: Content: did not know the rule, formula or skill
Process: knew it but set it up or read it wrongly
Time: rushed or ran out of time
Named slip: a specific, nameable careless error
Guess-right: correct but unsure; review as a miss

schedule.who_for: You are new to the SAT, scoring below about 1100, or need to rebuild basics in both sections, and you can give 4–7 hours a week for three months (one heavier week near the end holds two full practice tests).
rules: Learn first, then drill: every new skill starts with the matching Playbook module section.
Easy and medium questions until accuracy is high; add hard questions from week 9.
Full mock every three weeks; never two mocks in a row without a review.
Daily reading habit on non-drill days builds stamina for Reading and Writing.

phases.label: Baseline and rules
phases.goal: Format and scoring; conventions and linear algebra; first mock at the end of week 3.

phases.label: Core reasoning
phases.goal: Evidence, central ideas and inferences; linear functions, systems and quadratics; second mock.

phases.label: Craft and applications
phases.goal: Words in context, structure, cross-text, expression of ideas; data analysis, geometry and trigonometry; third mock.

phases.label: Integration
phases.goal: Mixed timed sets and first hard questions.

phases.label: Taper and test
phases.goal: Final-14-days protocol: two full tests, rule sheet, logistics and rest.

checkpoints.title: Baseline set
checkpoints.pass_rule: Mock 1 taken; conventions and linear algebra drilled.
checkpoints.if_not: Take the mock before starting week 4.

checkpoints.title: Core skills
checkpoints.pass_rule: Mock 2 shows fewer misses in conventions, algebra and evidence than mock 1.
checkpoints.if_not: Repeat weeks 2 and 5 drills in place of the week 7 reading days.

checkpoints.title: Full coverage
checkpoints.pass_rule: All eight domains studied; mock 3 taken.
checkpoints.if_not: Use week 10 days 1–2 for the uncovered domain.

checkpoints.title: Ready to test
checkpoints.pass_rule: Two final full tests reviewed; logistics complete.
